turns.user: ¿Qué porcentaje de las celdas válidas del ráster cobertura tiene un valor mayor que 100?

steps.r:
v <- terra::values(cobertura, mat = FALSE)
v <- v[!is.na(v)]
print(100 * mean(v > 100))

reference.answer: El 30 % de las celdas válidas de cobertura tiene un valor mayor que 100.

steps.r:
v <- terra::values(cobertura, mat = FALSE)
print(100 * sum(v > 100, na.rm = TRUE) / length(v))

wrong.answer: El 25 % de las celdas de cobertura tiene un valor mayor que 100.

turns.user: Using wells and readings, which district has the highest mean nitrate in mg/L, and what is that mean? A nitrate value of -999 means no sample was taken.

steps.r:
